title: AW27 Women's Woven Fabric Direction
summary: AW27 women's wovens: double-faced wool and cashmere, flannels, satins and crushed velvets, membrane suitings and heritage checks.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Separable double-faced woollens return in more varied weights; ultrafine yarns and tight knits make wool lighter and softer, with thermal comfort without synthetics<sup>[1]</sup>
- The Première Vision selection came out "silkier and more influenced by eveningwear codes" than expected: satins, crushed velvets and wool blends<sup>[1]</sup>
- Citywear suitings hide waterproof, breathable or windproof membranes, three-layer constructions and bi-stretch, so a jacket looks like a classic suit while performing like technical wear<sup>[1]</sup>
- Milano Unica: double-faced wool and cashmere, flannels and cashmere fleece ("Classic"); ripstops and ultralight nylon ("Freestyle"); lurex jacquards, sequin tulle, metallic velvets and lamé tweeds ("Romance")<sup>[2]</sup>
- Checks lead prints: Boland suggests four checks in one garment; Milano Unica shows pinstripes, herringbone, glen checks and houndstooth at micro and macro scale<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Fabric by fabric
sections.body:
| Fabric | Hand | Uses | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Double-faced wool and cashmere | Soft, unlined | Coats | Rising |
| Flannel | Brushed | Suits, skirts | Core |
| Satin and crushed velvet | Fluid, rich | Evening and day | Rising |
| Membrane-backed suiting | Classic look, technical | Coats, suits | Rising |
| Checks | Varied | Tailoring | Core |

design_implications: - Double-faced needs specialist finishing; plan sampling time.
